project_type: Next.js 15 App Router monorepo (apps/web) with Prisma, Tailwind, Framer Motion, GSAP, next-intl
build_system: npm workspaces + turbo, Next.js build in apps/web
test_framework: Node.js test runner (tsx --test tests/*.test.ts) and Playwright (tests/ui/)
build_command: cd apps/web && npx next build (requires DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, AUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL env vars)
verification_instructions: 1. npx prisma generate (after schema edits), 2. npx tsc --noEmit in apps/web, 3. npx eslint . in apps/web (informational)
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo is generated by tsc; prisma client generated in node_modules/.prisma
setup_instructions: export PATH=$PATH:/root/.nvm/versions/node/$(ls /root/.nvm/versions/node | tail -1)/bin; node_modules already installed
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Cannot run full next build without env vars (DATABASE_URL etc) but tsc --noEmit works. Push via github power push_to_remote only.
contribution_requirements: Admin code should NOT be modified. Keep commits focused and descriptive. Build must pass (tsc --noEmit) before pushing.

key_patterns.data_fetching: unstable_cache wrapping prisma calls with .catch(() => fallback), DB-first with demo data fallback
key_patterns.animation: GSAP via lib/gsap.ts and components/ui/gsap/, Framer Motion via lib/motion.ts
key_patterns.cart: Client-side CartProvider in components/cart/cart-provider.tsx, keyed by product id
key_patterns.analytics: PostHog via lib/analytics/ with typed events in events.ts
key_patterns.testing: Node test runner for unit tests, Playwright for E2E in tests/ui/
key_patterns.components: components/ root for shared, components/home/ for homepage, components/ui/gsap/ for GSAP

directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js), apps/mobile-customer, packages/shared. Web app: app/ (Next.js App Router pages), components/ (React components), lib/ (utilities), prisma/ (schema + migrations), tests/ (unit + ui)
